versions.name: Oceanography
versions.description: Measure salinity, temperature, and density, map the shelf, trench, and abyssal plain, tell swell from surf and a rip current from a tidal bore, and tow a plankton net to see what lives in the water.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
